meta.name: wordpress
meta.description: Operate connected WordPress sites through the NotFair MCP. Use for WordPress content, posts, pages, media, comments, terms, design, settings, plugins, themes, HTML files, or approved WordPress changes on a NotFair-connected site. Not the local Application-Password CMS setup used by SEO scripts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在对话里管理网站的文章、页面、媒体与站点设置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在经营网站,想不登录后台就能完成日常内容更新
copy.tagline_en: Manage your site's posts, pages, media and settings through chat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to update it without logging into the admin panel.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先完整读取插件里的 wordpress/SKILL.md，并把它当作当前工作流，然后通过 NotFair MCP 操作你已连接的 WordPress 站点，处理文章、页面、媒体等；读不到该文件就停下并报告打包错误。
howto.when: 当你要求对 NotFair 已连接的 WordPress 站点做内容、插件、主题等改动时触发；不适用于 SEO 脚本使用的本地 Application-Password CMS 设置。

say.text: 把站点上那篇文章的标题改一下
say.note: 对 NotFair 已连接的站点生效

say.text: 列出这个 WordPress 站点上的所有页面
say.note: 通过 NotFair MCP 连接读取

say.text: 在这个 WordPress 站点安装并启用一个插件
say.note: 属于已批准的站点改动

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the plugin's wordpress/SKILL.md and follows it as the active workflow, then operates your NotFair-connected WordPress site via the NotFair MCP — content, posts, pages, media and more.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for content, plugin, theme or other changes on a NotFair-connected WordPress site; not the local Application-Password CMS setup used by SEO scripts.
